name: OnboardingChecklist
purpose: A host-controlled setup checklist with measurable progress and optional actions per step.
description: A controlled setup checklist with explicit completion, optional action callbacks, and progress. Async actions do not imply completion; the application updates the items after its work succeeds. Optional steps are labeled and included in the displayed total.

props.name: description
props.defaultValue: "Complete these steps to get your team ready."

props.name: onCompletedChange
props.type: ((id: string, completed: boolean) => void | Promise<void>) | undefined

guidance.overview: A host-controlled setup checklist with measurable progress and optional actions per step.
usage: Update each item’s completed state from actual application results. Running onAction does not automatically mark the step complete.
Optional is descriptive text; optional items still count toward the displayed completion total. Adjust the supplied list if they should be excluded.
Without onCompletedChange, checkboxes are readonly while step actions can remain available.
accessibility: The section has a heading, numbered step context, associated descriptions, and a labeled progress bar.
Collapse hides the step controls; guarded asynchronous actions disable other changes and report success or failure.
context: Use for workspace setup, team onboarding, and staged adoption tasks that remain available outside a blocking wizard.
